_doc: Sea Folk third faction (game/SeaFolkManager.ts, state/seaFolk.ts). The war poisons the sea: contamination (0-100) rises with every wave and battle and falls with tribute. Above emergeAt a group rises at the start of a wave or a brawl and fights BOTH the demons and the humans; at bossAt the Leviathan joins (only one). Each kill levels the killer up (+N badge). Tribute pays them off: contamination drops and they spare the demons for truceWaves waves (they still fight the humans). Demons and humans fight back: any unit a Sea Folk creature attacks (or that comes within noticeRadius) turns on it with up to two nearby allies, chasing it up to the leash; melee units can strike a swimmer from the shore within waterReach. The Leviathan also rises at random (boss.randomChance per wave once the sea is restless) and sometimes carries a rune (boss.runeChance). Works in every game mode. waterOnly creatures (the Leviathan) swim only on water tiles and strike the shore from range.

desc.en: Fast, hopping biters that swarm anything bleeding.
desc.tl: Mabibilis at lumulundag na kagat na dinudumog ang anumang dumudugo.

skillDesc.en: Bites twice as fast at targets below half health.
skillDesc.tl: Dalawang beses na mas mabilis kumagat sa kalabang wala nang kalahati ang buhay.

desc.en: Trident singers who hurl bolts of seawater and mend their kin.
desc.tl: Mang-aawit na may trident na bumabato ng tubig-dagat at nagpapagaling sa kauri.

skillDesc.en: Heals every Sea Folk ally nearby.
skillDesc.tl: Pinagagaling ang lahat ng kauring malapit.

desc.en: Shelled river guardians that claw and hide in their shells.
desc.tl: Mga bantay ng ilog na may talukab na nangangalmot at nagtatago sa talukab.

skillDesc.en: Pulls into its shell, taking 60% less damage for 3 seconds.
skillDesc.tl: Nagtatago sa talukab at 60% na mas kaunti ang tama sa loob ng 3 segundo.

desc.en: The ancient sea dragon. Only one lives, and it rises only when the sea is near ruin.
desc.tl: Ang sinaunang dragon ng dagat. Iisa lang ito, at lumilitaw lang kapag halos wasak na ang dagat.

skillDesc.en: Crashes a wave around itself, striking every demon and human in reach.
skillDesc.tl: Nagpapabagsak ng alon sa paligid, tinatamaan ang bawat demonyo at tao na maaabot.

desc.en: Crashes a ring of water around itself, striking every demon and human in reach.
desc.tl: Nagpapabagsak ng singsing ng tubig sa paligid, tinatamaan ang bawat demonyo at tao na maaabot.

desc.en: A roar from the deep that slows every foe in a wide radius.
desc.tl: Atungal mula sa kalaliman na nagpapabagal sa lahat ng kalaban sa malawak na paligid.

desc.en: Opens a whirlpool that drags nearby foes toward the shore and batters them.
desc.tl: Nagbubukas ng ipoipo na humihila sa mga kalapit na kalaban papunta sa pampang at binubugbog sila.

bodyguards._doc: When the Leviathan rises, up to count Sea Folk swear to guard it: they stay near it, hunt whoever attacks it, and take share of every hit it suffers while within radius.

rank._doc: A minion whose + (from Sea Folk kills) beats its General's + swaps rank with it: the minion is promoted to General and the General is demoted.
